technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Combination with 00153, Kontrol edin: special notes.
When this fault code is flagged, it is important to Kontrol edin: other Kontrol Modülüs for fault codes.  Different slave modules for different systems may be on the same bus (wire), thus one failed item causes several other items no longer Gerçekleştirin: to factory design.
